Checkpoints are purely intra-slot state — they live in `slot.prompt.checkpoints` during a slot's lifecycle and are cleared when the slot is released. The inter-request prompt cache (`server_prompt_cache`) only persists token sequences and raw KV cache blobs, never checkpoint metadata.
